title: Atmosphere: A Love Story
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
summary: In the early 1980s, Joan Goodwin, a physics professor, joins NASA's astronaut program and falls in love with fellow trainee Vanessa Ford. Their relationship must remain hidden as they train for the Space Shuttle.
readIf: you like emotional, character-led historical fiction about space and love.
skipIf: you want a technical space story or an entirely happy romance.
